_comments: One daily job → AccountingERPEngine.SyncMasterData for every credentialed company.
JobTypeID is the seeded Action type (ActionScheduledJobDriver). Cron is six fields, seconds first:
`0 0 2 * * *` = 02:00:00 UTC every day. Concurrency Skip so overlapping runs do not double-pull.
Hosts disable this row rather than deleting it.

fields.Name: Accounting — ERP master data (daily)
fields.Description: Pulls chart of accounts, dimensions, and dimension values from every active Company Integration. Posts of journal batches are a separate engine verb, not this job.
